destinations.summary: The Turkish Riviera offers a unique mix of ancient history and natural beauty. Discover hidden coves, secluded beaches and charming harbour towns along a coastline that perfectly suits travellers seeking culture, relaxation and adventure.
destinations.metaDescription: Explore our curated destination guide to make the most of your luxury yacht charter in Turkey, from coves to ruins, we have covered all of the Turkish gems.
paragraphs: Turkey stands with one foot in Europe and the other in Asia as an axis where ethnicities and strong traditions meet. It acts as a bustling trading hub for precious goods and boasts a varied landscape of religious beliefs. This magnificent nation captivates and charms visitors with its vibrant and chaotic atmosphere, offering a cultural depth that leaves a lasting impression that is truly unforgettable. "If the world were a single country, Istanbul would be its capital”, such is the poignant description Napoleon Bonaparte gave of Turkey.

Indeed, Turkey's location has made it a crossroads of history and culture. From the ancient Silk Road traders to Alexander the Great and Julius Caesar, Turkey has welcomed and influenced numerous civilisations across the ages. With so much to explore along its storied coast, a luxury yacht charter in Turkey allows you to effortlessly discover all this diverse country has to offer.

Embark on a yacht charter in Turkey and discover the magnificent Mediterranean and Black Sea coastline, stretching a remarkable 4,400 miles. Along the enchanting Turkish Riviera stretch, also known as the Turquoise Coast, lies a true gem waiting to be explored, adorned with sunken remains and ancient rock carvings from the Greek and Roman civilisations.

Sail beneath the clear blue skies as crystalline waters shimmer under the warm Mediterranean sun. As the light fades, savour a glass of raki while the sun slowly sets over the majestic mountainous terrain, casting a moonlit glow that will leave you in awe.

From unwinding in a traditional Turkish hammam to exploring unspoiled beaches and the wonder of Mount Olympus, a luxury yacht charter in Turkey is an unparalleled journey through a treasure trove of adventure.

Adorned with untouched islands, secluded coves, and pristine beaches, the Turquoise Coast presents an idyllic escape for those seeking tranquillity. Dive deep into the ancient Myndos ruins, marvel at the prehistoric volcanic rock cones, or revel in bustling bazaars while sipping rose-scented tea. The serene blue skies and deep blue waters, teeming with playful dolphins, create a yachting haven, beckoning you to stay a while longer.

An idyllic fusion of Mediterranean and Middle Eastern influences, this enchanting land boasts a rich tapestry of ancient wonders, diverse landscapes and warm hospitality. From lively towns and tranquil fishing villages to modern marinas and chic resorts, a luxury yacht charter in Turkey offers no shortage of excitement.

Indulge in fresh meze and grilled seafood at charming al fresco restaurants in Bodrum. Immerse yourself in the vibrant bazaar of Fethiye and wander the narrow, cobbled streets of Antalya. Where you can experience the ultimate in privacy and comfort on the open seas, chartering a luxury yacht in these Turkish hotspots won’t disappoint.

Nestled between Europe and Asia, Istanbul offers a captivating skyline where the domes and minarets of historic sites blend harmoniously with modern skyscrapers and boutique hotels. Exploring the city, you will uncover the remains of the Roman and Byzantine empires, with notable examples such as the Hippodrome and the awe-inspiring Hagia Sophia, now a mosque.

One of the city’s iconic landmarks is the Blue Mosque, an impressive example of 16th-century Islamic architecture. Listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site example in 1985, it holds great cultural and historical significance.

Beyond the historic sites, Istanbul has much more to offer. You can delve into the lavish lifestyle of the Ottoman emperors at the Topkapi Palace, or immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of the Grand Bazaar, boasting around 4,000 shops. If you’re interested in contemporary art, you won’t want to miss the Istanbul Modern Museum.

Experience the epitome of a Turkish luxury yacht charter by anchoring in the stunning Marmaris Bay, where the rugged mountains meet the crystal-clear waters of the Mediterranean. This former fishing village, now a cosmopolitan hub, boasts one of the world’s most impressive natural harbours, attracting yachting enthusiasts from all over the world. Explore the charming old town with its traditional bazaar and Ottoman castle, built in 1522. Enjoy a range of watersports in the pine-clad bay, stroll along the waterfront and indulge in the local cuisine at one of the many world-class restaurants. Marmaris is the ultimate destination for those seeking a perfect blend of history, culture, and luxury.

With its charming whitewashed houses, bougainvillea cascading from every corner, and picturesque twin bays, Bodrum exudes a Bohemian flair that is sure to enchant all who visit. The blue flag beaches and tranquil bays provide ample opportunities for both relaxation and exploration, while history buffs can delve into the ancient world at the awe-inspiring ruins of the Mausoleum at Halicarnassus and Castle of St. Peter.

And as day turns to night, Bodrum’s vibrant nightlife takes centre stage, beckoning the elite with its enticing mix of artistic expression and cultural diversity. The perfect blend of relaxation, adventure, and culture, Bodrum is the ultimate destination for a luxury yacht charter in Turkey.

A haven of azure waters and verdant landscapes peppered with archaeological treasures, a visit to the captivating Gulf of Göcek is a must on any motor yacht charter in Turkey. The bustling port, known as one of the world’s most beautiful yachting destinations, is a registered area of special protection, preserving its natural beauty and charm.

Göcek’s historic harbour and numerous marinas offer the perfect starting point for yacht charters, while its sheltered bays provide ideal conditions for watersports enthusiasts of all levels. Indulge in Turkish Hammam at the opulent D-Resort Göcek, set amidst attractive gardens, private beach, and marina. A private yacht will also allow you to discover the charming nearby towns of Dalyan, Kalkan and Kaş, each with their own unique appeal and off-the-main-tourist-trail feel.

Nestled along the Turquoise Coast, Fethiye is a highlight destination of any Turkey luxury yacht charter. Brimming with history and natural beauty, this lively town offers the perfect blend of sophistication and seaside charm. Explore the Lycian tombs and sarcophagi that pay tribute to ancient Telmessos, while indulging in local delicacies like fresh fish and sweet Turkish Delight. For the ultimate indulgence, an exclusive yacht rental in Fethiye promises exclusive access to tranquil lagoons, secluded beaches, and crystal-clear waters ideal for swimming, snorkelling, and scuba diving. With a thriving market and welcoming locals, Fethiye invites visitors to immerse themselves in local culture, where a strong Turkish coffee can reveal one’s fortune.

Renowned for its delectable cuisine (most notably mezze), on a yacht charter in Turkey you can expect to savour a range of mouth-watering dishes, including patlıcan salatası (aubergine mash), semizotu (purslane weed, usually in yoghurt), mücver (courgette croquettes), dolma (stuffed vegetables) and much more. A perfect blend of Central Asian, Middle Eastern, and East Mediterranean cuisine ensures that every palate is catered to.

Indulge in the best of Turkish gastronomy while cruising along the mesmerising Turquoise Coast on a luxury yacht charter. From traditional Ottoman delicacies to modern fine dining experiences, there is no shortage of exceptional restaurants to visit on your voyage. We have handpicked five of the finest restaurants in the region that you simply cannot afford to miss.

Truly one-of-a-kind, this Turkish retreat offers a contemporary twist on Mediterranean and traditional Turkish cuisine, using only the freshest locally sourced ingredients. Maçakızı, often referred to as Turkey’s answer to Saint Tropez, is where bohemian A-listers have been flocking to for over four decades. The regal beach club and hotel is hugged by pines overlooking the azure-blue Türkbükü Bay, offering unrivalled barefoot elegance and a chic atmosphere. From pan-seared seabass to sundried tomato pesto lamb, the cuisine at Maçakızı is beautifully complemented with panoramic views and laid-back bacchanalia.

An off-shoot of the wildly popular French Riviera beach club of the same name, La Guérite is a VIP hotspot attracting those in the know. With multiple beaches, lounging areas, spa facilities, and restaurants under its umbrella, D-Maris Bay is the ultimate destination for a day of indulgence when exploring Turkey by yacht.

With its tropical landscaping, 360-degree sea views, and sultry ambience soundtracked by live beats, La Guérite is the epitome of boutique chic and St Tropez spirit. Indulge in the freshest seafood and Mediterranean favourites while enjoying a glass of wine as you take in the spectacular sunset. Share plates of mouth-watering lobster linguine, sea bass ceviche, octopus salad, and truffle fries, accompanied by flowing bubbles and attentive service.

A glamorous haven overlooking Bodrum Peninsula and the perfect complement to a Turkey superyacht charter, immerse yourself in tropical modernism at Fenix. Boasting a design that speaks a universal language, drawing inspiration from Barcelona, Miami, Marrakech, Dubai, and beyond. Its cosmopolitan menu tantalises taste buds with fresh sushi, Peruvian classics, and Mediterranean-infused dishes.

Try the signature Kokoreç, a succulent Turkish kebab. Impeccable mixology awakens the senses. As night falls, Fenix gracefully transforms into a vibrant nightclub, inviting you to dance beneath the stars. Embark on a divine culinary journey on a Turkish yacht charter—refreshing cocktails, international delicacies, and magical moments await.
located in the picturesque Yalıkavak Marina in Bodrum, the world-renowned Zuma offers an authentic and innovative taste of contemporary Japanese cuisine on your luxury yacht charter in Turkey.
The menu boasts a wide array of dishes with standouts such as miso-marinated black cod and ribeye steak with wafu dressing and garlic crisps, sure to delight your palate.

While enjoying the breath-taking views of the Aegean sea, unwind to the soothing sounds of Zuma’s chill beats and sip on refreshing cocktails from the restaurant’s extensive cocktail menu. Zuma is the perfect spot for an unforgettable night on your private superyacht hire in Turkey.

The perfect complement to any luxury yacht charter in Turkey, discover the gastronomic oasis that is Q Lounge at the exclusive D resort Göcek. Serving up spectacular views of the Göcek bay from every angle, Q-Lounge offers a dining experience that simply cannot be missed.

The menu is a fusion of contemporary Japanese cuisine, infused with local and Peruvian flavours, resulting in a tantalising and unforgettable culinary adventure. The sharing plates, elegantly styled, are perfectly accompanied by an extensive selection of 150 fine wines and signature cocktails that embody the Japanese-Peruvian inspiration of the restaurant. While the laid-back ambiance is an irresistible blend of stunning architecture, uplifting music from top DJs, and delightful cocktails.

As you prepare for an opulent superyacht excursion in the stunning waters of Turkey, indulging in the country’s mesmerising beaches is an absolute must. Delight in the ethereal beauty of the Turkish coastline, adorned with idyllic bays and immaculate sands that are sure to leave you in awe. The beaches of Turkey present a haven for those who relish in pure bliss and relaxation, with many only accessible by yacht.

Nestled along Turkey’s exquisite southern coastline lies the mesmerising Blue Lagoon, Ölüdeniz. A divine turquoise bay draped in lush forest and framed by majestic mountains and perfect white sand. A dreamy escape awaits travellers with a penchant for barefoot luxury. With its glistening crystalline waters beckoning you to take a dip, The Blue Lagoon has become a firm favourite for the superyacht set and the ultimate spot to unwind, soak up the sun, recharge and rejuvenate.

Tucked away in a serene cove a short cruise south from Ölüdeniz, lies the alluring Kabak Beach. A hidden paradise, coveted by those in pursuit of tranquillity. Exclusive and remote, only accessible by yacht or a steep descent down the mountainside, this gem remains a secluded paradise. The crystalline waters, the pebbled and white sand beach, and the peaceful surroundings are well worth the tender ride from Half-Moon Bay. Kabak Beach is a testament to the beauty of Turkey’s coastal treasures, perfect for those seeking seclusion on their luxury yacht charter in Turkey.

Indulge in the opulence of Turkey’s Turquoise Coast with a visit to Cleopatra Beach in Alanya. As you stroll along this stretch of powdery white sand, you’ll feel transported to a bygone era. According to legend, the captivating Queen Cleopatra herself once graced these shores, imbuing the beach with an irresistible allure. Set against the towering Alanya Castle and nestled amidst chic shops, cafés and restaurants, this sophisticated beach promises the ultimate in high-end leisure. Take a dip in the crystal-clear waters or simply soak up the sun, and revel in the bliss of this Turkish paradise.

On your Turkish superyacht charter a visit to the breathtaking Kelebekler Vadisi, also known as Butterfly Valley is a must. This secluded haven, accessible only by boat, is a veritable paradise for the nature lover. Nestled near the picturesque town of Ölüdeniz, the pristine beach boasts awe-inspiring vistas of verdant cliffs, lush flora, and is home to hundreds of butterfly species. Whether it’s swimming, hiking or simply revelling in your surroundings, Butterfly Valley will certainly leave a lasting impression.

On a luxury yacht charter in Turkey venture into the foothills of the Taurus Mountains and discover the majestic ruins of Olympos at one end of this historic beach and the mystical Chimaera flames at the other. The expansive bay that encompasses Olympos and Cirali Beach is so remote and well-preserved that it remains unspoiled, with just a handful of high-end restaurants between protected conservation areas providing a safe-haven for the endangered loggerhead turtles that make their nests on these sands. The natural splendour and exclusivity of this location will leave even the most discerning traveller in awe.

As the sun-kissed Turkish coastline unfurls before you on your superyacht charter, there’s one beach that beckons to those seeking beachside bliss. Patara Beach, an 18-kilometre expanse of pristine sand, is the ideal location to bask under the Turkish sun. Backed by undulating dunes and lapped by warm, crystalline waters, it’s no wonder that Patara has long been a windsurfing and kiteboarding hotspot. Named after the nearby ancient city, this beach offers not only natural beauty, but historical significance. The ruins of ancient temples provide a perfect backdrop for postcard-worthy photos, while the beach’s protected status ensures an exclusive escape from the bustle of everyday life. Don’t miss the opportunity to watch the sunset and loggerhead turtles hatch from the top of the dunes – a truly unforgettable experience.

Indulge in a journey through time as you set sail on your lavish superyacht charter in Turkey, where a plethora of enchanting historic sites await. Whether you are an avid history buff or simply seeking to explore the wonders of the past, Turkey’s timeless landmarks are certain to captivate and leave you in awe.

From the ancient ruins of Ephesus, where the remnants of a once-thriving civilisation still stand, to the majestic Temple of Apollo, an architectural masterpiece that has stood the test of time, Turkey’s historic sites offer a glimpse into the nation’s fascinating past.

Nestled in the idyllic pine-covered town of Demre lies the sprawling ancient city of Myra. Step back in time to the opulent lifestyles of the Greeks and Romans in the 5th century BC and explore the beautifully preserved amphitheatre, exquisite tombs, and stunning rock-cut structures that pepper the city. Delve into the secrets of the Roman baths and immerse yourself in the grandeur of the past. Myra is an enchanting metropolis that will transport you on an enchanting journey through Turkey’s rich cultural history.

Imposing and captivating, the Mausoleum at Halicarnassus stands as a testament to the magnificence of ancient architecture. This awe-inspiring tomb, constructed for Mausolus, a ruler of great influence in Caria, stands alongside the Pyramids of Giza and the colossus of Rhodes as one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Majestic columns, intricate sculptural reliefs, and a chariot bearing the images of Mausolus and his wife Artemisia once adorned this towering structure, which rose to a breathtaking height of 45m. Although destroyed in the 15th century, visitors can still marvel at the ruins of this grand tomb in Bodrum, Turkey. With its picturesque gardens and excavated columns, the site is a must-see for discerning travellers seeking to immerse themselves in the wonders of the past.

Once a thriving hub of the ancient world, the Ancient City of Ephesus is home to some of the most well-preserved ruins Turkey has to offer. Found near the modern-day city of Selcuk, admire the stunning grandeur of its fabled library, bask in the majestic splendour of the Temple of Artemis, and revel in the magnificence of the Great Theatre. Take time to discover the awe-inspiring feats of engineering of the ancient Roman aqueducts that still stand to this day. Ephesus, a true wonder of the ancient world, belongs on any Turkey yacht charter itinerary.

Indulge in the ultimate luxury experience on a private superyacht charter along the stunning coastline of Turkey. Discover the hidden gems of this ancient land, from secluded coves to charming seaside villages, all while basking in crystal-clear waters.

With an exceptional selection of vessels, and specialist Charter Consultants planning your bespoke Turkish yacht charter itinerary, explore ancient ruins, savour world-renowned cuisine, or simply unwind in privacy on your own luxury superyacht.
Contact us to plan your dream luxury yacht charter in Turkey and unveil the magic of this unforgettable destination.

destinations.name: The Red Sea
destinations.summary: Extending from the Suez Canal in the north to the Gulf of Aden in the south, the Red Sea is a stunning stretch of blue sea teeming with vibrant marine life.
destinations.metaTitle: Red Sea Yacht Charter: Reef Diving and Year-Round Sunshine
destinations.metaDescription: Charter a crewed yacht in the Red Sea and dive coral walls and wrecks in warm, clear water, with mild sailing conditions all winter. Enquire today.
destinations.lede: From the coastal treasures of Hurghada to the small island delights dotted across the sea, there are countless discoveries to be made on a Red Sea yacht charter. With an incredible underwater landscape, the area offers outstanding snorkelling and diving, whilst ashore vast mountains and spectacular deserts feature riches of their own.
paragraphs: Nestled between the desert and sea, Marsa Alam is home to the exclusive Port Ghalib Marina, surrounded by luxurious resorts, alluring spas and gourmet restaurants. A haven for diving enthusiasts, where dolphins and dugongs thrive, this area is also a world-renowned kite surfing destination. Nearby the stunning national parks of Gebel Elba and Wadi al Gimal are home to a variety of birds and desert animals and surrounded by mountains which were once mined for gold and emeralds.

Enjoy water sports in the wide, natural bay of Makadi, wander at leisure over the swathes of sandy beach and visit the Souk Makadi for lively night-time entertainment. Golfing enthusiasts will relish the 18 championship holes at Madinat Makadi Resort where the green overlooks the sea. Additionally, a snorkelling trip amongst the rare corals at protected Giftun Island should not be overlooked.

Whether you seek relaxation, sightseeing opportunities or activities, the vast Red Sea region offers a multitude of possibilities. The constant temperate climate, clear, warm seas and fascinating culture add to the enduring appeal.

destinations.summary: Open spaces, abundant wildlife and vast forests characterise the diverse terrain of Alaska. This is a perfect destination to indulge in outdoor activities such as mountain biking, skiing and kayaking.
destinations.metaDescription: The perfect charter destination for those who seek adventure, Alaska offers outdoor exhilarating activities such as mountain biking, skiing and kayaking.
destinations.lede: Open spaces, abundant wildlife and vast forests characterise the diverse terrain of Alaska. This is a perfect yachting destination to indulge in outdoor activities such as mountain biking, skiing and kayaking.
paragraphs: Beautiful on both land and sea, Alaska is an adventure lover’s paradise just waiting to be explored. Famed for grizzly bears and humpback whales, the incredible array of wildlife is never-ending, with stunning scenery to match.

Discover the town of Juneau, sample delicious local seafood and take in the traditional native totem poles throughout the region. National parks offer a glimpse of the rugged terrain and abundant wildlife of the region, while various hot spring sites offer a chance to relax. Travel the winding fjords past immensely powerful sheer granite walls and cascading waterfalls while fascinating misshapen icebergs drift by. Your captain and crew will be able to assist in a variety of activities including kayaking, trekking through lush forests, and exploring glaciers by air or by foot.

A totally tropical yachting haven, Bermuda is an idyllic destination with extensive cruising grounds tailor-made for those seeking the pinnacle of luxury on a private yacht charter. As the sails unfurl, and the anchor drops, discover the magic of Bermuda's stunning beaches, exciting dive sites, and picturesque coves that many dream of but only a few get to explore.
paragraphs: Influenced by a long colonial past, Bermuda’s whitewashed cottages and icing sugar mansions stand out hilltop amidst swaying palms, while luxurious resorts and spas sprawl shoreside.

Influenced by a long colonial past, Bermuda’s whitewashed cottages and icing sugar mansions stand out hilltop amidst swaying palms. The island beckons with luxurious resorts and spas sprawl shoreside, ideal for those who’ve chosen the intimate experience of a private yacht charter in Bermuda.

Renowned for a coastline fringed by pink-sand beaches, Bermuda is the ideal place to truly unwind. The unique island culture exudes a relaxed vibe perfect for luxury seekers. The opportunity to enjoy outdoor activities is plentiful. Whether looking to enjoy a round of golf, try your hand at paddle boarding, or simply to bask in the ambiance of this paradise during your Bermuda yacht charter, this is the spot.

Stop at vibrant Hamilton, the beating heart of Bermuda’s culture and economy. As the capital city, it offers more than just scenic beauty to those sailing on a private yacht charter in Bermuda. With picturesque streets strewn with eateries amidst the striking gothic towers of the cathedral, the energy here is enchanting. Snorkelling fans must head to east to Tobacco Bay where the waters are sublime. Moreover, for those on their Bermuda yacht charter journey, the art of relaxation can be achieved to perfection at pink-hued Elbow Beach. A trip to Bermuda isn’t just about the journey, but about the stories you’ll gather and memories you’ll make.

destinations.name: Florida
destinations.summary: Chartering a yacht in Florida is a wonderful way to explore the pretty islands of the Florida Keys and the relaxed Gulf Coast. Explore coastal cities, view wildlife and enjoy superb dining.
destinations.metaTitle: Florida Yacht Charter: The Keys, Gulf Coast and Biscayne
destinations.metaDescription: Charter a crewed yacht in Florida and cruise the Keys, Biscayne Bay and the Gulf Coast, with the Bahamas within a day of cruising. Enquire today.
destinations.lede: Chartering a yacht in Florida is a wonderful way to explore the picturesque islands of the Florida Keys and the relaxed Gulf Coast. Explore coastal cities, enjoy an abundance of wildlife and enjoy superb dining.
paragraphs: Offering a vast array of opportunities for fishing, diving and sheer relaxation, the Florida Keys provide a fabulous year-round cruising destination. Each island exhibits it’s own personality: in Key Largo discover mysterious reefs and shipwrecks while in Key West the sunsets will take your breath away. Offering the ability to start your charter from a variety of ports such as Fort Lauderdale, Miami and South Beach, this location is packed with options.
Extending from the south at Marco Island on Cape Romano to Venice Inlet to the north, the beautiful cruising areas of the Gulf Coast offer unspoiled natural beauty and protected anchorages.
With close proximity to the Bahamas and other exciting destinations, Florida can be visited individually or perhaps as part of a wider reaching itinerary.

destinations.summary: Stunning landscapes, charming coastal towns, a deep history and long traditions of fishing all add to the magic of a yacht charter in beautiful New England.
destinations.metaDescription: Widely considered the yachting capital of North America, New England offers an incredible selection of world-class restaurants and vast sandy beaches.
destinations.lede: Boasting a rich yachting heritage and packed with character, New England is a fascinating charter destination filled with plenty of fun and variety. From yachting stalwart Newport to picture perfect Martha's Vineyard, relaxed Cape Cod to the smart Hamptons, the New England coastline delivers a variety of charming towns and long stretches of beach.
paragraphs: With sprawling beaches and chic boutiques, art galleries and fine dining, there is so much to see and do in New England. Take time to explore a port town on Maine’s beautiful coastline, the lively city of Boston, one of Cape Cod’s islands and maybe the popular sailing town of Newport.
The weather is mild, with the nights usually cool and the days warm and sunny – ideal for exploring the rugged eastern coastline.

destinations.name: Norway

flags: site map pin (59.96, 11.05) is 270 km from the design reference; reference used

destinations.summary: Norway offers a dramatic yachting experience far removed from tropical destinations. Cruise through towering fjords, past cascading waterfalls and beneath rugged mountains.
destinations.metaTitle: Norway Yacht Charter: Fjords, Glaciers and Midnight Sun
destinations.metaDescription: Charter a crewed yacht in Norway and cruise Geirangerfjord, the Lofoten Islands and its glacier arms beneath the midnight sun. Enquire today.
destinations.lede: Without a doubt, Norway is one of the most beautiful places on earth. Host to a stunning natural scenery, it also boasts fabulous cities, captivating history and welcoming local people. Combined with a vast network of Fjords and waterways, this makes Norway an ideal destination to discover by yacht.
paragraphs: A vast bay stretching over 100km in the south-eastern corner of Norway, the Oslo Fjord is a prime destination to explore. The fascinating city of Oslo is truly a Scandinavian metropolis with a cosmopolitan feel. Enjoy the architecture and shopping in the vibrant city centre before venturing out to discover the wilder fjord, dotted with islands, each with its own identity and distinctive history. This is an ideal spot for fishing and water sports fun, where kayaking and canoeing allow you to discover the scenery in total peace.

On the west coast of Norway lies the city of Bergen – one of the most traditional in Norway. Discover unspoiled nature where ancient forests rise from deep fjords and sweeping meadows seem to merge with the horizon.

Further North, Svalbard is a Norwegian archipelago between mainland Norway and the North Pole. As one of the world’s northernmost populated areas, it’s known for its craggy, isolated terrain of glaciers and frozen tundra sheltering polar bears, Svalbard reindeer and Arctic foxes. A yacht charter destination for the true adventurer, Svalbard sees the Northern Lights become visible during winter, while summer brings the “midnight sun” – sunlight 24 hours a day. Explore the Bay of Isfjorden, the second longest fjord in Svalbard, surrounded by staggering mountains and quaint villages.

destinations.name: Chile
destinations.summary: With over 6,000km of Pacific Ocean coastline, deserts, glaciers, islands, lakes and volcanoes, Chile is a country of contrasts with incredible natural beauty.
destinations.metaDescription: Volcanos, islands and striking fjords comprise the fascinating Chilean landscape making it a breathtaking yacht charter destination.
destinations.lede: With over 6,000km of Pacific Ocean coastline, deserts, glaciers, islands, lakes and volcanoes, Chile is a country of contrasts with incredible natural beauty.
paragraphs: In the far south lies the wind-whipped lands that surround the vibrant town of Punta Arenas, the capital of the Magallanes province. The southernmost harbour on the continent is the gateway to visiting prime destinations such as the archipelago of Tierra del Fuego, the Beagle Channel, Isla Navarino and the famed Cape Horn. Punta Arenas is brimming with Latin American culture and is a truly fascinating destination.

To the north, there is a dazzling array of attractions to discover. The world surfing championships are held at Arica and Pichilemu, however the best surf spot for beginners is Punta de Lobos. Perhaps take time to explore the eerie mining ghost town of Humberston or watch flamingos and rheas at the Parque Nacional Lauca.

A cruise through the icy waters to the Strait of Magellan will allow you to see flocks of penguins and the magical gleam of the glaciers. Further north, in the winter months Chile’s coldest destinations transform into luxury ski resorts that attract the international jet-set, lured by fantastic skiing opportunities outside of the regular season. The towns of La Parva and Portillo are popular, exclusive resorts, conveniently located near the capital of Santiago de Chile.

Further north lies the amazing city of Valparaíso that appears to rise directly from the clear waters of the Pacific Ocean. Its breath-taking architecture, excellent restaurants, fascinating museums and fine art galleries make this a thriving cultural hotspot on the South American west coast. The fine seaside resort of Viña del Mar lies close by, tempting visitors with its wide promenades offering exceptional views across to wedding-cake mansions and soft powdery beaches that line the azure blue coast.

destinations.name: Ecuador
destinations.summary: On South America's western coast, astride the equator, Ecuador is wildly diverse. Rugged shorelines, Amazon jungle, peaks of the Andes and Galapagos isles are part of this amazing destination.
destinations.metaDescription: Rugged shorelines, Amazonian jungle, high peaks of the Andes and the wildlife-rich Galapagos isles belong to this amazing charter destination.
destinations.lede: Set on South America's western coast, astride the equator, the fascinating country of Ecuador is wildly diverse. Rugged shorelines, Amazonian jungle, high peaks of the Andes and wildlife-rich Galapagos isles belong to this amazing destination.
paragraphs: The first two UNESCO World Heritage sites ever created were the Galapgos and the city of Quito - Ecuador is certainly filled with spectacular natural variety. To fully experience local culture and history, the bustling cities across 24 provinces will give a true flavour. Capital city Quito, set to a stunning volcanic backdrop, is packed with attractions: Quito Cathedral and Basilica del Voto Nacional are stand-outs, together with many gorgeous parks.

Do not miss the opportunity for an immersive Amazon adventure. Encounter wildlife and indigenous plant life, while tribal communities delight visitors with cultural experiences. Alternatively the Ecuadorian Andes are brimming with exciting activities such as whitewater rafting, horse-riding, hiking and biking, all enjoyed in exquisite surroundings. Head to the small mountain town of Otavalo for retail therapy at the unique craft market or relax in the hot springs at Banos Banos.

Bordered by the South Pacific Ocean, Ecuador's meandering coastline is made up of many beaches and lively shore-side towns. Enjoy long velvet beaches at Puerto Lopez and, when the sun goes down, get lost in the sway of the many salsa clubs' rhythm. Nearby the beautiful Isla de la Plata is easily accessible by yacht for some amazing sight seeing. Nature-activities and eco-tours are found at Pueblo Ecologico Alandaluz, whereas Salango is the perfect beach for snorkelling or scuba diving.

destinations.name: Patagonia

flags: site map pin (-41.33, -69.55) is 952 km from the design reference; reference used

destinations.summary: Situated on the southern frontier of South America, bordered by Argentina and Chile, experience four seasons in one day when visiting Patagonia.
destinations.metaTitle: Patagonia Yacht Charter: Fjords, Glaciers and Wild Coast
destinations.metaDescription: Charter an expedition yacht in Patagonia and cruise the Chilean fjords, glacier faces and channels towards Cape Horn. Our consultants plan the route.
destinations.lede: Situated on the southern frontier of South America, bordered by Argentina and Chile, experience four seasons in one day when visiting Patagonia.
paragraphs: From fjords and glaciers to desert landscapes, spaces are large and silences filling them even larger; the possibilities for adventure are endless. Explore the enchanting Andes mountains of the north or vast rugged terrain in the south - this impressive region caters to the curious.

Explorers who arrived in Patagonia some 500 years ago described the area as exotic, wild and infinite in beauty - very little has changed today. The vibrant gaucho lifestyle and ranching history in Puerto Natales contrast against isolated natural treasures such as the Marble Caves and the jagged blue ice of Grey Lake. Alternatively adrenaline junkies are spoiled for choice with numerous watersports, ice field trekking and rafting.

The Torres del Paine National Park is simply outstanding: experience magnificent forests, ice-topped mountains, picturesque waterfalls and glassy lakes. Soak up stunning views over the Southern Ice Fields, discover the Milodon Cave, sail through the Ultima Esperanza fjord and encounter ethereal glaciers during a superyacht charter in Patagonia . Adventurous visitors may like to choose an itinerary to explore the very southern extremes, navigating through sea fjords, crossing the Straits of Magellan and setting course for Antarctica. Cruising amongst the hundreds of spectacular glaciers you will find an azure playground teeming with dolphins, killer whales and penguins.

Trekking and fly fishing are prevalent in Coyhaique and Puerto Aysen. Challenge yourself to climb the amazing peaks of Mackay or the Castillo. Relax and enjoy the captivating Carretera Austral with verdant forests and exceptional panoramas framing untouched nature. In Coyhaiques main square, the arts and crafts fair offering handmade products is perfect to purchase a special reminder of your luxury yacht charter in this unique destination.

destinations.name: Indonesia
destinations.summary: Indonesia is packed with character, fusing together different cultures and enchanting customs. This is a land of friendly locals and diverse wildlife, not to forget a selection of majestic volcanoes.
destinations.metaDescription: With over 17,000 islands, yacht charter in Indonesia offers unparalleled diving areas. Inland there are also must see sights such as the Borobudur temple.
destinations.lede: Indonesia is packed with character, fusing together different cultures and enchanting customs. This is a land of friendly locals and exotic wildlife, not to forget a selection of majestic volcanoes. Ideally explored by yacht, Indonesia is made up of 17,000 islands, only 8,000 of which are inhabited. A true sign of the region’s diversity, over 300 languages are spoken.
paragraphs: Running 5,000km along the equator, Indonesia is a truly unique luxury yacht charter destination. One of the largest islands, Sumatra’s landscape is made up of almost 100 volcanoes and features a huge variety of flora and fauna. Inland, the vast, ocean-blue lake of Danau Toba is a must-see, covering over 1700sq km and set high up among volcanic crests.

Throughout Indonesia, diverse native tribes populate the islands, each with a uniquely evolved culture; from the secrecies of the mystical Balinese to the incongruent beliefs of the Asmat people of Papua, all are wholly fascinating.

One of the most popular islands, Bali is perfect for leisurely travels on board a superyacht. The fabled “land of the gods”, Bali is known for for stunning beaches, historic temples and a striking landscape. In Java, explore intricate palaces and sacred wonders before travelling to the captivating slopes of Mount Bromo. For those seeking less-developed shores packing true adventure, head to Lombok for sweeping beaches and lofty Mount Rinjani or venture to the rustic, car-free Gili islands where traditional Bugis schooners can be spotted sail alongside you.

destinations.name: Malaysia
destinations.summary: An authentic medley of culture, scenery and bustling lifestyles, Malaysia is a truly unique and diverse yacht charter destination.
destinations.metaDescription: Malaysia is a diverse mix with cultures from Malay, Chinese and Indian influence, experience this perfect blend in a South China Sea yacht charter.
destinations.lede: An authentic medley of culture, scenery and bustling lifestyles, Malaysia is a truly unique yacht charter destination. Geographically diverse and comprising 11 states, the two landmasses of Malaysia are separated by the South China Sea.
paragraphs: In East Malaysia, the jungles of Borneo host spry orangutans in their dense cover. Home also to remote tribes, these dense forests are set against the backdrop of steep granite mountains. In contrast, the West Malaysian peninsula contains vibrant cities such as Kuala Lumpur and Putraja, bursting with fascinating architecture.

Malaysia is consistently voted as one of the world’s best diving destinations and visitors will be inspired to explore many hidden gems on a superyacht charter in the region. Charter a yacht in the Andaman Sea to visit the beautiful Langkawi archipelago, made up of 99 islands, only two of which are inhabited. Equally impressive Redang is favoured for crystal clear waters and coral reefs that surround this island, playing host to a variety of clownfish, baby sharks and jellyfish.

In addition to the wide array of natural wonders on offer, Malaysia is also a foodie’s paradise. Many yachts cruising in the region employs chefs that are well versed in the local cuisine, but visitors can also head to dry land to enjoy Chinese-Malay “Nonya”, Indian curries, Malaysian street food and Dayak delicacies. Friendly, welcoming and generous, the locals love celebrating and socialising during their hundreds of colourful festivals taking place each year.

destinations.summary: Thailand’s Andaman Sea is one of the highlights of Southeast Asia, known for dramatic limestone islands, hidden lagoons and secluded beaches. With calm waters and spectacular scenery, it offers a unique blend of culture, cuisine and adventure.
destinations.metaDescription: Thailand is surrounded by stunning islands such as Koh Samui and the world famous Koh Yao islands, hotspots for yacht charter in the Andaman Sea.
destinations.lede: This fun-loving country with its tropical beaches, opulent royal palaces, wonderful cuisine and friendly culture is a superb destination for a luxury yacht charter.
paragraphs: The largest and most developed island in Thailand, Phuket is the superyacht hub of Asia. For peace and tranquility, you will find the outer islands just a short cruise away – all of which offer exceptional snorkelling and scuba diving.

Take life at your own pace cruising the clear, turquoise waters set against a backdrop of lush green hills. Explore sheltered lagoons and enjoy the plentiful marine life. Diverse culture and tradition thrive in this enchanting and colourful superyacht haven. Asian tradition melds with western comforts; rows of rice paddies juxtapose serenely with ornate temples and exquisite beaches. The islands of the world’s largest archipelago remain loaded with possibilities for adventure: remote villages, ancient ceremonies, culinary exploration and sheer unadulterated beauty.

destinations.name: Fiji
destinations.summary: Palm-lined beaches and blue lagoons punctuate the rugged landscape in Fiji, where you will be spoilt for choice when it comes to the perfect anchorage spots.
destinations.metaTitle: Fiji Yacht Charter: Cruise Coral Reefs and Private Isles
destinations.metaDescription: Cruise Fiji by crewed superyacht, from the Yasawa chain to Beqa Lagoon diving and 300 islands of reef. Our consultants arrange Fiji charters year round.
destinations.lede: Palm-lined beaches and blue lagoons punctuate the rugged landscape in Fiji, where you will be spoilt for choice when it comes to the perfect anchorage spots.
paragraphs: Tranquil beauty thrives in the temperate climate of Fiji, which has a total of 333 islands and is home to the third longest barrier reef in the world – that also serves as a whale sanctuary to protect migratory species.

Located in the heart of the South Pacific and famous for its soft coral diving, white sand beaches and pristine natural environment, Fiji is a leader in eco-tourism. Main islands Viti Levu and Vanua Levu offer luxury hotels and resorts, whilst many islands are uninhabited and home to arboreal expanses interspersed with dramatic volcanic craters, dazzling waterfalls, coastal mangrove forests and majestic rainforests.

Explore the archipelago’s exquisite beaches, swim amongst shoals of gentle shark near Viti Levu and the giant manta rays off the beautiful beaches of Nacula, or snorkel the stunning coral reefs of Ovalau and the Lomaiviti group. When chartering a luxury yacht in this idyllic country, you can be sure of an utterly enchanting experience that you will remember forever.

destinations.name: French Polynesia
destinations.summary: Stretching over 2,000km and comprising more than 100 islands in the South Pacific, French Polynesia is famed for its coral-fringed lagoons, white and black beaches and towering waterfalls.
destinations.metaDescription: Soak up the warm climate and embrace the tranquil vibe during your superyacht charter in beautiful French Polynesia.
destinations.lede: Stretching over 2,000km and comprising more than 100 islands in the South Pacific, French Polynesia is famed for its coral-fringed lagoons, white and black beaches, rugged backcountry and towering waterfalls.
paragraphs: Meander between islands strewn with lush tropical rainforests, lofty volcanoes, deserted beaches and isolated anchorages. Savour delicious local fare or enjoy the vibrant nightlife as the sun sets. The list of superyacht itinerary opportunities is truly endless in this incredible part of the world.

Whales, dolphins and turtles may greet the bow wave as you sail, whilst snorkelling or diving guarantees a discovery of exotic underwater world amongst the coral reefs and shallow inlets. On land, friendly locals are keen to share their rich culture and fascinating traditions. For nature lovers, be sure to take the time to explore the country’s verdant jungles teeming with beguiling and rare inhabitants.
With its turquoise lagoons, warm climate and laid-back vibe, French Polynesia is the perfect place to relax and take it slow during your luxury superyacht charter.

destinations.name: New Caledonia
destinations.summary: A French territory with one of the world’s largest lagoons and an enormous barrier reef, the South Pacific archipelago of New Caledonia offers exceptional scuba-diving.
destinations.metaTitle: New Caledonia Yacht Charter: The Largest Lagoon on Earth
destinations.metaDescription: Charter a crewed yacht in New Caledonia and cruise the largest enclosed lagoon on earth, a UNESCO site of coral reefs and islets. Enquire today.
destinations.lede: A French territory with one of the world’s largest lagoons and an enormous barrier reef, the South Pacific archipelago of New Caledonia offers exceptional scuba-diving.
paragraphs: Influenced by French traditions from its colonial past and set against a backdrop of outstanding natural diversity, this stunning destination is a delight to the senses.

The New Caledonia Barrier Reef, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and home to many species of indigenous sea life and coral, stretches some 1500km, encasing Ile des Pins and other islets. Providing a multitude of protected and secluded anchorages, most of these stunning isles are uninhabited.

New Caledonia weaves a rich tapestry of culture thanks to its location and colonial past; the native Kanaks preserve this heritage with tributes through music, dance, art and sculpture. The French influence is very much alive today in both language and food. In the capital Noumea, the colonial buildings and Kanak architecture are ubiquitous, while local markets are a delightful fusion of east meets west.

Expect colourful French cuisine with a tropical influence when dining ashore – lovingly prepared and beautifully presented. French cheese and wine are readily available together with intensely flavoursome locally grown fruit and vegetables – ideal for your dedicated onboard chef to prepare a wonderful variety of sensational dishes.
Offering a perfect combination of amazing landscapes, exceptional cruising areas and superb hospitality – New Caledonia is the perfect destination for your next yacht charter adventure.

destinations.name: The Great Barrier Reef
destinations.summary: As the healthiest, largest and, most beautiful coral reef on the globe, the Great Barrier Reef is one of Australia’s premier yacht charter destinations.
destinations.metaTitle: The Great Barrier Reef - Ocean Independence
destinations.metaDescription: As the healthiest, largest and, most beautiful coral reef on the globe, the Great Barrier Reef is one of Australia’s premier yacht charter destinations.
destinations.lede: As the healthiest, largest and, without a doubt, the most beautiful coral reef on the globe, the Great Barrier Reef is one of Australia’s premier destinations. Spread over a breathtaking 2,300km, this is the perfect opportunity for a South Pacific island hopping superyacht adventure thanks to calm seas and a mild climate.
paragraphs: The reef’s greatest attraction lies in its phenomenally diverse underwater world, with snorkelling and scuba diving rated amongst the most spectacular in the world. Even the sheer grandeur of just the corals is enough to make visiting worthwhile. However, this is combined with an amazing variety of marine creatures that populate this azure garden of Eden. Tropical fish, fascinating whales, playful dolphins, sea turtles, sharks and seasnakes make this a wholly vibrant spectacle, totally unmatched elsewhere on this planet.

Seabirds thrive, with a diversity of species beyond your wildest imagination. Michaelmas Cay, a 200m stable coral sand island, is home to 38+ species with some months seeing flocks of 100,000 birds visiting this popular nesting site. Raine Island National Park is the most important seabird rookery in the Great Barrier Reef World Heritage area together with supporting the world’s largest green turtle nesting population. The scale of wildlife in this part of the world can only be described as exceptional.
