Because of the relative inaccessibility of Formentera, the island has retained its old-world charm and is unfettered by mass tourism. A popular hangout for haute hippies in the 60s and 70s who came from Ibiza for some respite, the artists market in El Pilar has a distinctly bohemian vibe. For a brush with fame, grab a table at Juan y Andrea restaurant or, for a slower pace of life, head to Es Calo, a small fishing village with a beautiful beach and perfectly clear water teeming with tiny fish. Order paella or aroz negro (black rice) and switch off your phone.

destinations.name: Ibiza
destinations.summary: Ibiza is so much more than just a party island: it ranks as one of the most popular Mediterranean sailing grounds thanks to its natural beauty and consistent easterly winds.
destinations.metaDescription: Book your Ibiza luxury yacht charter to enjoy all of the island's hidden gems. Read our insider guide to Spain's most eclectic island. Discover more here.
destinations.lede: Ibiza is so much more than just a party island: it ranks as one of the most popular Mediterranean sailing grounds thanks to its natural beauty and consistent easterly winds.
paragraphs: Part of the Balearic Islands, Ibiza is nestled amidst the Mediterranean Sea and lapped by crystal-clear waters. An Ibiza luxury yacht charter offers the best way to explore the island and enjoy all of its hidden gems.

For those looking to be in the heart of the action, Marina Botafoch, which is in the centre of Ibiza Town, provides a range of opulent amenities and services. Docked here, you’ll never be too far from the activity due to its close proximity to the well-known nightlife locations.
Ibiza Marina, another prestigious marina in Ibiza Town, is renowned for its upscale stores, eateries, and bars. For those looking for a more exclusive experience, this is the ideal location.

Santa Eulalia Marina is the best option if you’re seeking a calmer and more welcoming setting for families. This marina, which is tucked away in the quaint village of Santa Eulalia, provides a laid-back atmosphere, stunning beaches, and top-notch food choices.

L’o is an essential stop for every yacht charter in Ibiza, offering live entertainment and breathtaking views of Dalt Vila and Ibiza Town. This famous Marina Botafoch cabaret and restaurant offers an amazing dining experience.
Situated in Marina Ibiza, Cipriani is a classy Italian restaurant that offers delectable fare and a glitzy atmosphere.

Amante Beach Club is the ideal location for a special supper. Perched high above the gorgeous Sol d’en Serra beach, this spot is an outstanding dining experience with an exquisite Mediterranean menu and stunning vistas.

Cala Bonita is the place to go if you want to eat traditional Spanish food. This adorable beachfront restaurant serves up classic cuisine cooked with ingredients gathered locally in a lovely environment.

Ibiza’s Old Town, which is classified by UNESCO, is a must-see location in Dalt Vila. Walk through the winding cobblestone lanes and discover the impressive range of old historic buildings, such as the Santa Maria Cathedral and the Ibiza Castle.
Yachts frequently dock off the southwest coast of Ibiza near the mysterious rock formation known as Es Vedrà. Relax on your yacht while taking in the stunning sights and the sunset.

Formentera is a quiet paradise with immaculate beaches and crystal-clear waters that is only a short boat journey from Ibiza. Visit the lovely town of Sant Francesc Xavier or moor your boat and enjoy the island’s natural splendour.

Cala Comte is one of Ibiza’s most beautiful beaches and a great place to unwind for the day. This is the ideal location to anchor and spend the day swimming and tanning thanks to its turquoise waters and breathtaking vistas.

Aquatic Sports: Enjoy some water sports like jet-skiing, paddleboarding, or snorkelling while enjoying the pristine waters. A lot of yacht charters come equipped, making it simple to discover the stunning undersea environment near Ibiza.

Beach Clubs: There are many beach clubs in Ibiza where you may unwind, eat, and dance the day away. The most well-known beach clubs are Ushuaa, Nikki Beach, and Blue Marlin. Remember to reserve a space because they tend to sell out quickly.

Cruises at dusk: From your yacht’s deck, you can enjoy Ibiza’s renowned sunsets in one of the best ways possible. Visit well-known locations like Café del Mar or Es Vedrà to experience the mesmerising sunset views.

Yoga and Wellness: During your yacht charter, rejuvenate your body and soul with a yoga session or spa treatment. In addition to visiting one of Ibiza’s famed spa facilities like Atzaró Spa or Hacienda Na Xamena, many luxury yachts also provide onboard wellness amenities.

Ibiza is the ideal location for a luxury yacht charter because of its breathtaking surroundings, top-notch restaurants, and exciting nightlife. There is no better way to experience the magic of Ibiza than by mooring in the best marinas on the island and delighting in the top restaurants and attractions. So get ready to go on your ideal yacht rental in Ibiza and make lifelong memories.

Contact us to make sure that your yacht charter experience is customised to your needs and preferences. Before setting sail, we’ll make sure that everything is in order because there is much more to the ideal yacht charter than the location.

destinations.name: Mallorca
destinations.summary: Located off the east coast of Spain, Mallorca is known as much for its well-preserved architecture and culture as it is for its remarkable beaches lapped by crystal clear water.
destinations.metaTitle: Mallorca Yacht Charter: Palma, Formentor and Quiet Calas
destinations.metaDescription: Charter a crewed yacht in Mallorca and cruise Palma, Cap de Formentor and the quiet limestone calas of the Tramuntana coastline. Enquire today.
destinations.lede: Located off the east coast of Spain, Mallorca is known as much for its well-preserved architecture and culture as it is for its remarkable beaches lapped by crystal clear water.
paragraphs: Docking at one of Mallorca’s top marinas is essential for a stress-free and luxurious yachting vacation. These marinas provide first-rate services and facilities, guaranteeing that your Mallorca yacht charter will be exceptional.

Port Adriano, in the island’s southwestern corner, is a cutting-edge marina designed by none other than legendary superyacht designer, Philippe Starck. It has 492 moorings for boats up to 80 meters in length, making it an excellent facility for superyachts. There are a variety of high-quality restaurants, upscale shopping, and marine-related services available on-site.

Located in the Bay of Palma, Puerto Portals is the ultimate of glitz and refinement. Luxury yachts up to 60 meters in length can dock at this marina, which also features an eclectic collection of bars, restaurants, and boutiques. If you want to mingle with A-listers and other notable people, this is the place to be on a superyacht charter in Mallorca.

Mallorca is a foodie’s dream, with restaurants ranging in quality from renowned Michelin-star attractions to hidden gems. Get some of the best food the island has to offer at one of these esteemed restaurants.

The beautiful Es Fum restaurant can be found inside the St. Regis Mardavall Mallorca Resort. Chef Thomas Kahl has earned the restaurant a Michelin star with his creative takes on Mediterranean food. A meal at Es Fum will be one you’ll never forget, thanks to the restaurant’s breathtaking patio that looks out over the Mediterranean.

Zaranda, part of the five-star Castell Son Claret hotel, holds the distinction of being Mallorca’s lone two-Michelin-star eatery. Chef Fernando P. Arellano’s inventive and memorable gourmet journey highlights his love of regional delicacies.
The fascinating variety of Mallorca’s sights stems from the island’s long and varied history and culture. These must-see locations will immerse you in the island’s cultural treasures.

Palma Cathedral, popularly known as La Seu, is a breathtaking Gothic masterpiece and one of the island’s most recognisable buildings. With its commanding vantage point over the harbour, this building is sure to impress as a backdrop for your Mallorca yacht rental.

Bellver Castle is located on a hill with breathtaking views of Palma and the Mediterranean. The Museum of the City’s History is located in this remarkable circular fortification and offers a fascinating look into Mallorca’s past.

Mallorca is a paradise for the affluent traveler, with a wide range of services and amenities available for their enjoyment. If the cultural and food attractions aren’t enough, there’s plenty more to do.

See the best of Mallorca’s wine country on a personalised trip. Experience the best of the region’s winemaking by seeing private wineries, tasting barrel samples, and dining on gourmet dishes served with wine. The island’s lush soil and special atmosphere allow for the production of wines that promise to impress even the most seasoned connoisseurs.

Mallorca’s many top-tier golf courses make it an ideal vacation destination for golf aficionados. Play a round of golf on the pristine greens of Son Gual, Alcanada, or Son Muntaner, three of the island’s most prestigious courses.

Relax at one of Mallorca’s exclusive beachfront establishments. Some of the most upscale establishments on the island include Nikki Beach, Purobeach Palma, and Anima Beach Club, all of which have fine cocktails, delectable cuisine, and breathtaking ocean views.

Take a private helicopter ride over Mallorca to see the island in a whole new light. Flying over the island’s stunning shoreline, steep mountains, and quaint towns will be an experience you’ll never forget.
A trip to one of Mallorca’s lavish spas is the perfect way to round off your opulent vacation. These havens provide a wide variety of spa services to help restore one’s spirit, body, and mind.

One of the largest and most lavish spas in Europe is the Arabella Spa at the St. Regis Mardavall. The ideal spa experience consists of indulging in trademark treatments, chilling out in the peaceful indoor and outdoor pools, and taking use of the large hydrotherapy circuit.
Relax in the spa at Cap Rocat, housed in a historic fort. Spa services such as massages, facials, and individualized health plans are available at this exotic, private place.

destinations.name: Menorca
destinations.summary: Located in the northeast of the Balearic Islands, the island of Menorca is only 50 by 16 kilometres in size, yet offers ample to see and do during a Menorca luxury yacht charter.
destinations.metaDescription: A Menorca yacht charter provides unmatched access to turquoise waters and gorgeous bays. Luxury and privacy await you on your yacht.
destinations.lede: Located in the northeast of the Balearic Islands, the island of Menorca is only 50 by 16 kilometres in size, yet offers ample to see and do during a Menorca luxury yacht charter. Family-friendly and offering more spectacular vistas than you can shake a camera at, this tiny island is favoured by nature lovers, water sports enthusiasts, and culture enthusiasts in equal measure.
paragraphs: A private crewed Menorca yacht charter brings you to a landscape dotted with picturesque fishing villages and whitewashed farms. Almost half of the island is a nature reserve, a hotspot for a wide variety of insects and birds. Blue sargatanas lizards dart over hot rocks and through dry grass while birdsong fills the air. Menorca’s coastline is famed for its fabulous beaches, which are lapped by the azure blue waters of the Mediterranean Sea. However, the best are tucked away in secluded coves – wild, wide, and windswept Cala Macarella, Son Saura, and Cala Pregonda are best accessed on your private Menorca luxury yacht charter.

Menorca’s southern beaches are dusted with white sand, while the beaches on the west are dotted with jagged rocks. The northern region of the island boasts dark sand and strong winds. This makes it a favoured spot with surfers, particularly around the picturesque village of Fornells. The port city of Ciutadella has retained its Medieval charm. Striking churches and palaces, picturesque harbours, and narrow, romantic side streets help to remind visitors of the island’s rich history and are a must-visit. If you charter in Menorca during the month of June, then don’t miss the colourful fiesta of Sant Joan, held every June in Ciutadella, offering multiple days of celebrations filled with local food, drink, and vibrant entertainment. It’s in the metropolis Mahón that you’ll find modern Menorca.
